source.description: One reviewed six-panel graphite-and-colored-pencil contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep exactly five heavy oval chain links on one rising diagonal, alternating face-on and edge-on orientations with four readable interlocks. No broken link, lock, hook, lettering, or extra hardware.

process_strategy: Map all five outer and inner link envelopes plus four overlap windows in pale perspective construction, convert those same footprints into alternating metal rings with rear contours stopped at each interlock, add thickness and shadow before color, and limit the final panel to stronger keeper lines and restrained metal shading.

final_elements.name: diagonal guide five link envelopes and four overlap windows
final_elements.description: A rising diagonal path with exactly five successively smaller outer and inner oval envelopes and four pale interlock windows.

final_elements.name: five alternating outer and inner chain-link contours
final_elements.description: Exactly five thick oval metal rings alternating face-on and edge-on while following the same perspective path.

final_elements.name: four interlocking overlaps and metal thickness bands
final_elements.description: Four readable over-under connections with rear contour segments stopped beneath the neighboring link and slim inner-rim thickness bands.

final_elements.name: edge hatching and broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: Short directional graphite hatches on the established metal and one broken shadow tucked beneath the nearer three links.

final_elements.name: restrained blue-gray and warm-ochre pencil tint
final_elements.description: Sparse blue-gray metal tint with small warm-ochre reflected accents, leaving paper and graphite texture visible.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: At each of the four pale overlap windows, the rear link contour stops at the neighboring foreground ring instead of being drawn through and erased later.

rejection_checks: Keep exactly five chain links, one rising diagonal, one crop, and one perspective scale in all six panels.
Every link must keep the same outer contour, inner opening, rotation, and neighbor connection after it appears.
All four rear-link contour gaps must be reserved before the foreground segments darken; no keeper line may be erased to fake an interlock.
Do not add a broken link, hook, lock, rope, hand, lettering, logo, decorative border, background scene, or extra hardware.
The final panel may not introduce a new link, overlap, thickness band, hatch cluster, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must look like tactile graphite and colored pencil on paper, not rasterized vector art, polished 3D metal, or a glossy icon.
